titulo.alumno:
«Префикс и новое значение»
Prefix and a new meaning

intro: A prefix can form the perfective, but it can also add a direction or a new meaning: писать — написать, переписать, подписать.

frases.alumno: The editor rewrote the introduction of the article.
The author signed the contract in the morning.
